requirement_text: The application must be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting.
requirement_reference: "it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting"

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app to open quickly so that I do not have to wait to access information.
user_story.Acceptance: Given the app is closed, When I launch the app, Then all main content is displayed and usable within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application must function reliably even with limited network coverage, providing graceful degradation of features.
requirement_reference: "developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage"

user_story.story: As a user in an area with poor signal, I want the app to work reliably so that I can still access information.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I have a weak network connection, When I use the app, Then all critical features (news, results last known state) remain usable with appropriate user feedback on unavailable features.

requirement_text: The application must remain usable offline, allowing access to core features and last-known data if the connection is lost temporarily.
requirement_reference: "app remains usable offline, even if it temporarily loses connection"

user_story.story: As a user, I want to use the app even when offline so that I can view previously loaded news and results.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I have no internet connection, When I open the app, Then I am still able to access the last loaded news, results, and information.

requirement_text: The application must support at least 100,000 simultaneous users without any loss of performance.
requirement_reference: "up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss"

user_story.story: As an app owner, I want the app to serve large numbers of users during peak times so that all users have a good experience.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a popular match is ongoing, When 100,000 users use the app concurrently, Then the app remains as responsive as normal.

requirement_text: All application modules and the user interface must remain consistent and operational even if the external server providing data is updated.
requirement_reference: "all modules and the user interface are fixed components ... remain consistent even with external server updates"

user_story.story: As a user, I want the app layout and features to remain stable even when back-end data sources are updated so that I am not confused by unexpected changes.
user_story.Acceptance: Given an external API update, When I use the app, Then all modules and the UI continue to function as before with no visible disruption.

requirement_text: The application must undergo thorough testing and support processes before release to identify and resolve technical problems early.
requirement_reference: "app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early"

user_story.story: As a developer, I want every release to be fully tested so that issues are caught before users experience them.
user_story.Acceptance: Given a new build, When QA is performed, Then all critical workflows are tested and defects corrected before release.

requirement_text: User feedback and app reviews must be continuously evaluated to improve app functionality.
requirement_reference: "user feedback and app reviews are continuously evaluated to improve functionality"

user_story.story: As a product owner, I want ongoing user feedback review so that the app evolves and issues are addressed.
user_story.Acceptance: Given new user feedback or reviews, When they are analyzed, Then relevant improvements are planned and tracked for future updates.

requirement_text: All personal user data must be processed in compliance with the GDPR.
requirement_reference: "all personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR"

user_story.story: As a user, I want my personal information to be protected so that it is only handled according to GDPR standards.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I register and provide personal data, When the data is processed, Then all operations comply with GDPR (e.g., consent, access, erasure, transparency).

requirement_text: The application must be deployable and fully functional on both Android and iOS mobile operating systems.
requirement_reference: "mobile football app that will be available for Android and iOS devices"

user_story.story: As a user with either an Android or iOS device, I want to install and use the app so that I have access regardless of my platform.
user_story.Acceptance: Given I download the app from the Play Store or App Store, When I install and launch it, Then all features are available and work as specified on both platforms.
